document.title: BCGModelling — project flow

primary_docs.role: Pipeline, data, metrics, status, §13 launch gate
Evo2 LoRA training, memory, commands, checkpointing

document.summary: MIBiG + antiSMASH-derived JSONL records are merged and stratified into train/val/test splits. Evo2 7B is fine-tuned with LoRA (DeepSpeed + PEFT) on class + taxonomy–conditioned BGC nucleotide text. Checkpoints and logs land under /data2/ds85/bgcmodel_runs/. An eight-metric suite (evaluate_bgc.py) scores real and generated sequences. Phase 1 uses COMPOUND_CLASS + Evo2 taxonomic tags only; later phases add compound conditioning.

environment.pythonpath_note: Use PYTHONPATH=src when running src-backed pipeline scripts (evaluate_bgc, etc.).

stages.title: 1. Raw sources
stages.description: MIBiG records and large-scale antiSMASH GenBank tar; taxonomy from NCBI.

stages.title: 2. Merge & stratified splits
stages.description: Combine MIBiG + antiSMASH JSONL; stratified train/val/test with documented class balance.

stages.title: 3. Chunk index (production long-seq)
stages.description: Optional but recommended before chunked training: per-line nt lengths and meta (max_prefix_tokens, prefix_slack_tokens) for deterministic windows.

stages.title: 4. Readiness gate
stages.description: Verify data files and external tools (antiSMASH DBs, Pfam, UniRef50, …) before long runs.

scripts.purpose: Human or JSON report; archive per production launch

stages.title: 5. Fine-tune (LoRA on Evo2 7B)
stages.description: DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 wrapper, bf16, block activation checkpointing (default on), PEFT LoRA. Long sequences: truncate (legacy/pilot) or chunk (production) with prefix-aware tiling. CE loss masks prefix tokens (H3). Resume stores epoch, micro_step_in_epoch, RNG in client_state (H1).
stages.legacy_full_ft: scripts/finetune_evo2.py (does not fit 80 GB H100 for long L)

stages.title: 6. Queued GPU operations (shared H100)
stages.description: Shell wrappers wait for GPU idle + free-memory hold, then launch deepspeed inside micromamba.

scripts.purpose: Multi-L smoke matrix; padded train collation by default
L=32k pilot on real combined splits + post-run verifier
Wait for pilot dir processes to exit + success check → resume test

stages.title: 7. Evaluation & smoke
stages.description: Eight-metric suite on JSONL or FASTA; optional skips for fast dev.

scripts.purpose: M1–M8 metrics (antiSMASH class, Pfam domains, ESMFold, …)

stages.title: 8. Inference / generation (downstream)
stages.description: Use saved adapter from final_adapter/ or checkpoints/step_*/adapter with Evo2 loader; condition with same prefix format as training. Generation samples during training may be written under output_dir/samples/ per FINETUNE_GUIDE.

decision_log_highlights.decision: Prefix tokens masked in CE (H3); loss not comparable to older runs
client_state: epoch, micro_step_in_epoch, rng_state + dataloader skip-ahead (H1)
